# Font Awesome Free 5.15.1

Vendored from the official `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free` npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/-/fontawesome-free-5.15.1.tgz

`css/all.min.css`, `webfonts/*`, and `LICENSE.txt` are unmodified upstream files.
Keep the CSS and webfonts directories together: the stylesheet uses relative
`../webfonts/` URLs. The site serves these files locally so contact icons do not
depend on an external CDN.

See `LICENSE.txt` for the upstream icon, font, and code licenses.
